creativeDirection: A hand-cut paper diorama photographed like a theatrical shadowbox, combining collage portraiture, painted sci-fi backdrops, and tactile stagecraft.
scene: Inside a long abandoned greenhouse made from white brick and glass, viewed straight on at waist height like a proscenium stage, with a cracked central aisle leading to a luminous floral shrine.

elements.element: a red devil-like figure with one purple bat wing stands as the main shrine attendant, cut from painted paper and haloed by swirling flame shapes
two young girls appear as a single framed cameo portrait tucked among hanging patterned paper leaves near the shrine, their warm pink-orange tint softening the scene
the focal shrine is a huge yellow flower whose center holds a baby face encircled by sprinkled candy-like spheres

a glowing yellow planet hangs to the left above the greenhouse rafters while a floating red female figure drifts diagonally through the upper right, with mechanical consoles and cables built into the base of the shrine
an upside-down shirtless performer becomes a small paper acrobat tumbling across the foreground floor amid tangled cords and stage debris
four men with fists thrust forward are transformed into oversized cutout spectators emerging from the lower left shadows, their hands projecting toward the viewer
the greenhouse rear wall is rendered as a white brick surface, stark and graphic behind the central installation
three sunglassed men become a cool-toned photo-strip of tiny pinned thumbnails and one larger clipped portrait panel along the lower right structure

coverSummaries.description: A brightly coloured surreal illustration shows a red devil-like humanoid figure standing upright in the center, with small horns, pointed ears, and one visible purple bat-like wing. The figure is outlined with a glowing pale edge and raises one hand near its head. Behind it is a blue, cloudy oval area resembling outer space with scattered white star-like dots, surrounded by swirling flame-like bands of yellow, orange, and red that fill the frame.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: red devil-like figure with a purple wing

coverSummaries.description: A tinted photograph shows two young girls close together, smiling and facing slightly toward the camera. One girl is centered and the other is at right, with their heads touching. At left is the curved back of a white chair in the foreground. The upper portion of the cover has a dense repeating floral or fan-like pattern. The whole image is heavily colour-treated in pinks, purples, and orange.
coverSummaries.medium: colour-treated photograph with patterned graphic background

coverSummaries.description: A large yellow flower fills most of the image against a pale off-white background. In the center of the flower is a black-and-white baby’s face, surrounded by a ring of round candy-like balls covered in multicoloured sprinkles. The composition is framed by a thin dark border with rounded corners.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: baby face centered inside a yellow flower with sprinkled candy spheres
coverSummaries.medium: mixed-media collage combining photograph and graphic elements

coverSummaries.description: A dark space-themed illustration features a large glowing yellow planet or orb on the left and a star-speckled black background. On the right, a red nude female figure floats or twists diagonally with long hair streaming upward. Along the bottom are mechanical and electronic-looking components in orange, red, blue, and black, including boxy panels, cables, and a ray-gun-like form. A partial white humanoid figure appears cropped at the far right edge.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: floating red female figure in outer space
coverSummaries.medium: painted or digitally composited sci-fi illustration

coverSummaries.description: A black-and-white live performance photograph is centered within a thick red border. In the photo, a shirtless person is upside down in a handstand or dive-like pose on a cluttered floor with cables. Another person stands in the background near amplifiers and drum hardware. The scene is cramped and energetic, with wires snaking across the floor and dark club-like surroundings.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: upside-down shirtless performer among stage cables
coverSummaries.medium: black-and-white concert photograph with solid colour border

coverSummaries.description: A studio portrait shows four men standing close together and thrusting their fists toward the camera, making the hands appear large in the foreground. One man at right is shirtless and wears shiny metallic-looking trousers; the others wear dark or patterned clothing. Their hairstyles are long and styled, and the background is a plain brownish studio backdrop. The composition emphasizes the extended fists and the group’s faces behind them.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: four men extending clenched fists toward the camera

coverSummaries.description: A minimal graphic cover shows a flat white brick wall pattern spanning the entire image, with thin pale blue-grey lines marking the bricks. In the center is red hand-drawn paint-like writing, but no figures or objects besides the wall itself.

A high-contrast portrait photograph shows three men from the chest up against a white background. All three wear dark sunglasses and face forward, with the central figure slightly in front. The image is tinted in cool blue-grey tones. Along the bottom runs a narrow strip of tiny rectangular thumbnail images in various colours.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: three men wearing sunglasses in a tight portrait
coverSummaries.medium: high-contrast tinted photograph with thumbnail strip

prompt: Inside an abandoned greenhouse built from white brick and broken glass, viewed straight on at waist height like a theatrical proscenium, a cracked central aisle leads to a luminous floral shrine; the primary subject is a monumental yellow flower altar at center with a black-and-white baby face in its core, encircled by round candy-like spheres covered in multicolored sprinkles, and beside it stands a red devil-like attendant with small horns, pointed ears, one visible purple bat wing, and a pale glowing outline, raising one hand near its head; above left hangs a glowing yellow planet against a star-speckled dark cutout sky, upper right a red nude female figure floats diagonally with long hair streaming upward, the base of the shrine is crowded with boxy mechanical panels, cables, and a ray-gun-like component, in the foreground a small upside-down shirtless acrobat tumbles across tangled stage cords and debris, lower left four men with extended clenched fists emerge as oversized paper spectators projecting toward the viewer, near the shrine a single small framed cameo contains two smiling young girls cheek-to-cheek surrounded by dense floral patterned paper leaves, the back wall is a stark white brick pattern, and along the lower right structure sits a cool blue-grey portrait panel of three men in sunglasses plus a narrow strip of tiny multicolored thumbnails; hand-cut paper diorama, mixed-media collage, gouache-painted pieces, printed photo fragments, visible scissor edges, layered shadowbox construction photographed as a real miniature set; strong central hierarchy with the flower shrine dominant, the devil attendant secondary, supporting figures distributed at the edges, dramatic raking light from below and behind creating crisp shadows through the paper layers; palette of sulfur yellow, ember red, hot orange, lavender pink, blue-grey, chalk white, and deep black, with a feverish playful uncanny mood. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
